name: samsung-notes-mcp
description: Let Claude read your Samsung Notes: typed text, handwriting pages, photos and PDFs such as invoices. Never changes your notes. Unofficial.
long_description: Claude can list, search and read your Samsung Notes, see handwritten pages, and open attached photos and PDFs such as invoices and receipts. When you ask, it saves renamed copies of attachments into a folder, for example every invoice named by date, vendor and total. It works with Samsung Notes for Windows automatically, or with a folder of notes exported from the Samsung Notes phone app. It never changes your notes. Not affiliated with Samsung.

tools.name: notes_overview
tools.description: Where notes come from, folders, totals and problems.

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: List or search notes by words, folder, date, attachments or handwriting.

tools.name: read_note
tools.description: Read a note's typed text, tables, attachments, and which pages hold handwriting.

tools.name: get_page_image
tools.description: See a page as an image, including handwriting.

tools.name: get_attachment
tools.description: Open an attached photo or PDF, such as an invoice.

tools.name: save_attachments
tools.description: Save copies of attached photos and PDFs into a folder, under names Claude chooses.

exports_dir.title: Exported notes folder (optional)
exports_dir.description: Leave empty if you use Samsung Notes for Windows. Otherwise choose a folder of .sdocx files exported from the Samsung Notes phone app (select notes → Share → Samsung Notes file).

save_dir.title: Save folder (optional)
save_dir.description: Where Claude saves copies of attachments, such as invoices, when you ask. Leave empty for the “Samsung Notes” folder in Documents. To keep them in Google Drive, OneDrive, iCloud or Dropbox, choose a folder inside that service's synced folder.
